The '''Rescue at Riflor''' or '''Skirmish on Riflor''' was a small-scale mission undertaken by [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to save [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]], who were cornered by groups of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] on the planet [[Riflor/Legends|Riflor]].

==Background==
Following disastrous [[Battle of Jabiim]] Obi-Wan Kenobi was presumed missed in action. Many in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] believed him to be dead. His [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] Anakin Skywalker, who had doubts about his master's death, was assigned temporarily under tutelage of [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], until the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] would make a decision about his fate as a Jedi padawan.

The future events proved however that Anakin had been right all the time. After [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] victory on [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], Kenobi and his loyal comrade-in-arms [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] Alpha-17 had been captured by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] and Confederate commander [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who had subjected both of them to torture. The prisoners had managed to [[Escape from Rattatak|escape]], but hot pursuit by Separatists forces, including [[Vulture-class starfighter|Vulture starfighters]], had damaged their stolen starship and made the escapees crashed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-controlled planet Riflor. Some bounty hunters, very eager to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], had killed Confederate soldiers to take full credit for capturing Obi-Wan and Alpha-17.

Following [[Battle of Varonat]], in which the Jedi destroyed [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces, Anakin sensed that his old master was still alive, but he was in serious trouble. Ki-Adi-Mundi, convinced by fellow Jedi Masters [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], agreed to join Skywalker to track down Kenobi.

==The skirmish==
[[File:Wr_Rep62.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Obi-Wan fighting two bounty hunters.]]
On Riflor Kenobi and Alpha-17 were fighting the bounty hunters led by [[Rigo]]. Though the fugitives were doing their best they were outnumbered and Rigo decided it was much safer to kill them than gain a bounty by capturing them. At the last moment Skywalker saved Kenobi's life by cutting off Rigo's arm. The remaining bounty hunters opened fire, but they were no match for three Jedi and one [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]]. The victors left the planet without alarming additional Separatist forces about their presence.

==Aftermath==
A report about Kenobi's survival boosted morale to the Jedi overwhelmed by the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]]. Skywalker was glad to be his padawan again. Alpha-17 said goodbye to Obi-Wan, saying he was chosen to train new [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Anakin suggested to him to name the future clone troopers, instead of calling them by serial numbers.
